body.p: After , , , . Owns src/xslt_read.c, src/xslt_static.c, tests/xslt_read_test.c, src/xslt_ast.c and tests/xslt_ast_test.c (the functions src/xslt_ast_internal.h declares, ). Arena tree to stylesheet AST: XSLT element and attribute rules (XTSE0010, XTSE0090), standard attributes, whitespace stripping of the stylesheet, use-when with static parameters and variables, shadow attributes, xsl:include and xsl:import with precedence (XTSE0180 cycles), simplified stylesheets, forwards-compatible behaviour. Done when every in-scope stylesheet module reads or fails with the expected XTSE code (attr-use-when, attr-static, attr-shadow, decl-include, decl-import, misc-forwards ≥ 90% once 4.15 runs them). Done 2026-10-19 (): src/xslt_ast.c, src/xslt_read.c with src/xslt_read_internal.h, src/xslt_static.c with src/xslt_static_internal.h, tests xslt_ast and xslt_read. Of 8,712 in-scope cases 7,281 read as expected (or fail with the expected code), 1,323 expect a later error, 108 do not (55 ~T patterns, 17 xsl:record).
